messages:
maria (oncall): Morning handoff — quick recap of overnight incidents and current status. TL;DR: brief service degradation in eu-west ~2026-03-15 03:12–03:16 UTC where ~2.3% of prod requests returned 503s. Root cause: embedding-autoscaler thrash combined with increased KV-cache eviction churn. Pager fired, mitigations applied, system stable now.

incident-bot: Pager fired: embedding-autoscaler-thrash (severity: P2) at 03:08 UTC -> 03:12 UTC. Pages to @oncall and @sre. Links: https://alerts.redwood.company/alert/EMB-AUTO-487

ops-bot: Deploybot: Autoscaler rollout abc123 failed health checks at 03:06 UTC, rollback initiated automatically.

maria (oncall): What we did: scaled embed pool in eu-west, reverted autoscaler to last-known-good config, increased eviction headroom temporarily, enabled model-fallback route for high-latency requests. Observed error window ~3m, now back to normal p95.

jared: Can you confirm customer impact surface? which tenants saw 503s?

maria (oncall): Impacted mostly Dedicated tenants pinned to eu-west long-sequence model endpoints. Top-volume tenants notified by CS: AcmeCorp, NovaAI, Teachly. I left notes in their support tickets. No billing issues reported, just request failures.

ben: Who's primary / secondary for next 12h? any coverage gaps to call out?

maria (oncall): Primary = ben (you). Secondary = jared. I'm on warm-standby until 10:00 UTC if anything comes up for follow-up or customer comms. No gaps currently; coverage confirmed for eu-west and us-west.

maria (oncall): Runbooks and quick links: https://redwood.company/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler and https://redwood.company/runbooks/kv-evictions. Also playbook snippet I used below.

maria (oncall): commands used during mitigation:
```bash
# scale up embed pool (eu-west)
kubectl -n redwood scale deployment/embed-pool-eu-west --replicas=6
# revert autoscaler rollout
git checkout v1.2.1-autoscale && kubectl apply -f autoscaler-prod.yaml
# temporarily increase kv eviction headroom
/opt/redwood/bin/kvctl set eviction_headroom 0.15
```

jared: Metrics to watch — embedding-p95, autoscaler-rebalance-rate, kv-evict-rate. I added a short-lived alert: autoscaler.rebalance_rate > 5/min -> page.

ben: Actions for next shift (assign to themselves unless noted):
1) Short-term: add 30s cooldown to autoscaler (eng-7830).
2) Mid-term: add canary fallback route to model-small when embed latency > 1500ms (inc-4821).
3) Run controlled eviction simulation tomorrow 09:00 UTC against staging.
4) Customer follow-up: CS to confirm client-side retries are adequate.

maria (oncall): I'll create the tickets and attach logs + graphs. Tickets created: #INC-4821, #ENG-7830. Postmortem stub created at https://pm.redwood.company/INC-4821-postmortem.

ops-bot: CI gate: next autoscaler rollout is blocked until the postmortem and an infra-qa signoff are attached. :lock:

ben: Ack. I'll pick up the 30s cooldown and the canary route. Will coordinate with Platform for staging sim. Ping me in #product for customer comms. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): Thanks — leaving a short checklist for whoever takes the morning shift:
- Confirm no further 5xx in eu-west for next 2 hours.
- Verify embeddings-p95 < 800ms across tiers.
- Follow up on tickets ENG-7830 and INC-4821, move postmortem to draft.
- If autoscaler.rebalance_rate spikes again, escalate to oncall-manager.

ben: Understood, will update this thread with status updates.

maria (oncall): End of handoff. :wave:
